gene_inclusion: q<0.05 in at least one cell, then all available eligible cell-gene pairs
screen: coloc.abf with p1=p2=1e-4 and p12 in 1e-6,1e-5,1e-4
multi_signal_trigger: default PP.H4>=0.80 and H4/(H3+H4)>=0.80, or prespecified H3/H4 ambiguity with PP.H3+PP.H4>=0.80 and ratio in [0.20,0.80]

reclassification.STABLE_H4: default gate plus low-p12 ratio>=0.50 and corrected PF50 does not reverse
reclassification.WEAKENED_H4: H4 predominant but misses strict robustness
reclassification.QC_FAIL: identity, LD, convergence or coverage failure
